# A guide with a deliberate counter-example

Never write this:

```example
The same vendor as before, still wet, lit at 3500K in a 10-second shot.
```

Write this instead:

```
NO TEXT IN THE IMAGE: none.
LOCATION: @MarketStall. Counter in frame throughout.
AUDIO:
  Ambient: market noise.
  0-1s: a
  1-2s: b
  2-3s: c
  3-4s: d
  4-5s: e
  5-6s: f
  6-7s: g
  7-8s: h
```
